senses.gloss: (Ar. תָּחַב) (v. חָבָא) [to hide,] to insert, stick, dip.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:9:3">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>תּוֹחֵב בשפוד וכ׳</he> he may stick up (the fruits in the store room) with a spit or a knife, and take them out; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:3:3">Y. Sabb. III, 5ᵈ</cite> bot. Ib. XVII, 16ᵇ top <he>לִתְחוֹב בו</he> to stick something on it. Bab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:8">Kil. I, 8</cite> <he>אין תוחבין זמורה וכ׳</he> you must not stick the shoot of a vine into a melon (on the tree) that the latter may throw its juice into it.

<cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 3:12">Tosef. Ḥag. III, 12</cite> <he>תוחב … בכוש וכ׳</he> he picks the cake up with a reed or a chip; Y. ib. III, 79ᵇ <he>תּוֹחֵף … בשפוד</he> (not <he>משפוד</he>); a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="V00350"><he>תָּחוּב</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="V00723"><he>תְּחוּבָה</he></cite> &c.

<cite ref="Yevamot 116b:16">Yeb. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>כזית … ת׳ בקרקעית וכ׳</he> a piece of a corpse of the size of an olive stuck (hidden) in the bottom of the ship. Ohol. XVI, 2 <he>ת׳ בכותל</he> stuck in the wall.

<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:8">Mikv. X, 8</cite> <he>חץ שהוא ת׳ באדם</he> an arrow sticking in a human body. Ohol. III, 4 <he>היו תְחוּבִים בידי אדם</he> if they were stuck in by human hands; a. e.—V. <cite ref="V00350"><he>תָּחוּב</he></cite>.
